newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares steam ahead, index record seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares steam ahead, index record seen.

text.p: Leading Russian shares rose in morning trade on Tuesday, and traders said a continuation of Monday's optimistic investment mood could push the Russian Trading System index to a record high in the next few days.
The Russian Trading System index of 22 shares opened at 335.18 after closing on Monday at 334.59. The index hit a record high on February 20 this year at 349.27.

"I think that this week we'll reach a new high. There's very little left to go now," said Trinfiko senior trader Grigory Pensky, adding that the market could easily set a new record in the course of the day's trading.
Market leader UES EESR.RTS jumped to $0.2800 at GMT 0725 from $0.2720 on Monday but fell back to $0.2735 by 0840 GMT.
Regional power company Mosenergo MSNG.RTS rose to $1.390 from $1.352. Irkutskenergo IRGZ.RTS was also up in opening trade but was unchanged at $0.275 at GMT 0840.

Traders said optimism on Wall Street in the last few days was contributing to the spread of spring fever on the Russian market and saw the uptrend set to continue up until the market holiday May 9-11.
"It's not explicit, but if the Dow Jones goes up, the Russian market goes up, and everyone's optimistic and in a springlike mood," said Pensky.

The Dow Jones industrial index rose to a record 7214 high on Monday, fueled by investor expectations of a capital gains tax cut in the offing and mounting evidence that inflation remains in check, Western analysts said.
Inflation indicators earlier this year sparked fears that the Federal Reserve might raise interest rates at its meeting on May 15, making investment less attractive.

Some Russian dealers said there could be some profit-taking at the end of the week but they said prices would continue to rise throughout the day on active foreign and domestic demand, the latter fueled by Russian banks shifting money into equities.

"I think growth ought to continue because this morning there was very active buying. Volumes are good and most likely the index will rise," said CentreInvest trader Alexander Pankov. "Everyone is buying very actively."
